SourceDocument.description: A specific file, SQL source, or captured web page; records origin, retrieval date, and independence.

VehicleModel.description: A BMW or competitor model scoped to generation, model year, and variant when known.

Market.description: An explicitly defined market; country-to-market mappings are configured, never guessed.

Feature.description: A canonical capability or experience; VFC labels are source annotations and aliases.

CatalogItem.description: An option or package within one catalog edition; availability is an evidenced capability claim.

Evidence.description: An original record, excerpt, or statistic with a source locator. Repeated classification rows remain one feedback record.

Signal.description: One scoped interpretation: experience, sentiment, capability, study finding, commercial indicator or trend.

CustomerNeed.description: A customer outcome synthesized from supporting and challenging signals.

Trend.description: A time-scoped synthesis of indicators; projections remain labeled as forecasts.

Assumption.description: An explicit unproven premise with its impact and a validation plan.

Requirement.description: A revisioned proposal for a successor vehicle, justified by evidence and reviewed separately by a human.

Decision.description: An immutable human review event targeting one exact requirement revision.

IN_SOURCE.description: Locates original evidence in its captured source.

DERIVED_FROM.description: Traces an interpretation, catalog item or trend to inputs. Signals and items use Evidence.

CONCERNS.description: Associates an interpretation or proposal with a canonical feature.

SUPPORTS.description: Provides supporting evidence, with an explicit rationale and scope-transfer explanation.

CHALLENGES.description: Provides opposing or limiting evidence; sentiment alone does not determine this relationship.

ADDRESSES.description: States the customer outcome a requirement is intended to deliver.

JUSTIFIED_BY.description: Provides the evidence chain and rationale for a proposed requirement.

DEPENDS_ON.description: Makes a forward-looking or inferential premise explicit.

REVIEWS.description: Targets one requirement revision without mutating the proposal or source evidence.

COMPETES_WITH.description: A scoped competitive comparison chosen for a market and segment, not assumed from brand alone.

SUPERSEDES.description: Links a newer revision to an older revision of the same entity type.

DESCRIBES.description: Connects one product or competitor capability claim to its catalog-edition item.

INCLUDES.description: A package includes an item within the same source edition; not an availability assertion.

BASELINED_ON.description: References an evidenced BMW product capability for the proposed change intent.

IS_VARIANT_OF.description: Identifies an explicit variant's model generation; does not propagate equipment availability.

scope_authority: properties.context is authoritative; do not separately maintain conflicting ABOUT edges.
review_state: Derived from human Decision events for the exact Requirement id and revision. A new revision starts unreviewed.
link_traversal: Store each canonical edge once. Traverse incoming and outgoing sides; inverse_name is a display/API label, not a separately stored relationship type.

propose_requirement.effect: Returns a validated candidate snapshot; leaves the base unchanged.
propose_requirement.actor: software; service binds identity and checks authorization

review_requirement.effect: Records a human decision for one exact requirement revision.
review_requirement.actor: authenticated human; not available in the agent proposal interface

storage: SQL tables, join tables, or a NetworkX MultiDiGraph can represent the same contract. No storage engine is required by this ontology.
